en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Abu Asama, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
Seek Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from the Assaults of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> by the night and the day’.
I said, ‘And what are the Assaults of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Seizing upon the disobedience’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from ibn ‘Usamah who has said the following:
‘Seek refuge with Allah from His striking you at night or during the day.’
I (the narrator) asked him, ‘What is Allah’s striking?’ The Imam said, ‘It is Allah’s punishing for sins.’”
